summary: PR 3351 is valid test-only hardening for an already-fixed source path. The recorded base and the reporter's cited aa8c950a3 revision already emit the requested WARNING when Mamba capacity reduces concurrency. The candidate adds no runtime fix, but its focused regression passes on the exact commit and accurately guards cap arithmetic, warning severity, exact capacity, and the zero-capacity failure. It should not be represented as a failing-before/passing-after or full original-issue fix.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual checkout resolver reduced requested=8, max_mamba_cache_size=10, ratio=5 to effective=2 and emitted an actionable WARNING.
The exact candidate's issue-shaped warning regression, exact-capacity boundary, and below-one-request startup failure all passed (3 tests).
The candidate regression and nine adjacent Mamba allocation/ratio tests passed (12 tests).
Validated 39/5 floors to 7, 41/5 preserves requested 8, DP=2 conversion, a tighter token-capacity limit, and automatic request-limit capping.
After fetching the cited upstream object, the reporter's revision was confirmed to call logger.warning for the same Mamba concurrency cap.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned GPU was inventoried as one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), but the reviewed change and measured resolver path are CPU-side. No unrelated GPU smoke was treated as issue evidence.

remaining_counterexamples: The top-level /server_info max_running_requests remains the configured value; only nested scheduler internal state exposes effective_max_running_requests_per_dp.
The candidate injects the five-slot ratio and does not validate its derivation through a real GLM-5.3-Flash plus DFlash configuration.
The candidate does not reproduce the reported throughput curve or concurrency behavior on the named model and two-node hardware.
remaining_limitations: The GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 target weights and DFlash2 drafter weights were unavailable.
The available architecture was one MI355X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not two DGX Spark GB10/sm_121 nodes with CUDA 13 and TP=2/nnodes=2.
No production or native source changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The candidate test passes on the recorded base and therefore is regression-only hardening, not failing-before/passing-after proof of a candidate production correction.
